SASBDB entry SASDQT9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDQT9/)

Human RAD51 F86E/A89E with the BRC4 peptide, 20 mM HEPES, 50 mM sodium sulfate, 2 % sucrose,
pH 8.0, 15 degC, Diamond B21.
Publication: Rinaldi et al., Angew Chem Int Ed 2023, DOI 10.1002/anie.202312517.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDQT9.dat    SASBDB media/intensities_files (q already in A^-1)
  SASDQT9_fit1.fit                 SASBDB media/fitting_files (FoXS, q in A^-1, "#" header)
  SASDQT9_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB media/pdb_file (AlphaFold 2.2 model with hydrogens)
One fit (FoXS, header chi2 9.30571913 = SASBDB 9.305719; SI Table S3: 9.31). No file was
modified. 2026-11-13: the paper and SI were read (papers are the source of truth): buffer and
15 C agree with SASBDB; the wavelength is the paper's 0.9537 A (SASBDB: 0.9464 A, a conflict).
